Above this sits a large scoop of white ice cream or whipped cream. The dessert is topped with a cluster of dark red/purple spherical fruits (resembling grapes or lychees) and surrounded by bright green leafy garnish (resembling lettuce or mint). The background shows a blurred wooden table and chair legs.

artifact_observations.location: Green leafy garnish surrounding the scoop
artifact_observations.reasoning: The green leaves have an overly uniform, plastic-like sheen and lack fine vein details. They appear slightly fused with the white scoop in areas, suggesting AI generation struggles with complex overlapping organic textures.
The individual fruits lack clear separation and stems. They appear to melt into one another and into the green leaves, creating a nonsensical biological structure. The texture is waxy and indistinct.
The elliptical curve of the glass rim is slightly inconsistent; the left side appears thicker and less defined than the right, suggesting minor geometric warping common in AI generations.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'density' of the white scoop. If the classifier identifies it as whipped cream or meringue rather than ice cream, this is a significant semantic alignment error despite visual similarity.
